name: Pomme - Autonomous Agricultural Automation Robot w/LiDAR and CV
description: Hack The 6ix Winner. Built an autonomous rover+robotic arm robot that uses SLAM and computer vision to autonomous navigate and pikc up fruits, automating a largely hand-done process.
bulletPoints: Built with React Native + PyTorch Mobile, 98% inference accuracy on a 5k image test set
Fine-tuned a ResNet-18 model on a custom 12k image dataset of diseased/treated leaves
Real-time classification at 25ms per frame with 4MB model size via quantization
Offline-first architecture so the model runs with zero network calls

name: SynthWave Studio
description: A browser-based music sequencer that renders an animated 3D synthwave scene with React Three Fiber.
bulletPoints: 3D scene powered by @react-three/fiber with custom GLSL shaders for the grid and neon glow
Step sequencer built with Tone.js, supporting 8 tracks of 16-step patterns
WebGL audio analysis drives the camera pulsing to the beat via Web Audio API
Exported as a static site on Vite, deployed to Vercel with instant cold starts

name: OrbitDB Explorer
description: A decentralized knowledge graph explorer that syncs documents peer-to-peer using OrbitDB and IPFS.
bulletPoints: Wired up an OrbitDB docstore with CRDT conflict resolution over a libp2p pubsub mesh
Rendered an interactive force-directed graph with d3 and WebGL for 5k+ node datasets
Implemented a custom diff renderer so only changed nodes are re-synced between peers
Added end-to-end encryption for private graphs using RSA key pairs stored in localStorage

name: TaskForge CLI
description: A Rust-powered developer productivity CLI that scaffolds React components, Express routes, and test stubs from templates.
bulletPoints: Parses a YAML schema to generate type-safe components with configurable naming conventions
Zero-deps core written in Rust and compiled to a single native binary via Cargo
Plugin system lets teams ship custom templates as WASM modules loaded at runtime
Used by 200+ devs internally; cuts new feature setup time from 15 min to 20 seconds
